title: Pixlera
description: Pixlera is a texture pack that makes your game look better with updated and cleaner textures. It changes lots of things in a simple way so the game still feels original but more polished and nice to play.
body: Pixlera is a smooth and clean texture pack that improves the look of your game without making it feel too different. It adds a variety of redesigned textures for blocks, items, and the environment, giving everything a fresher and more modern feel. The goal of Pixlera is to keep the original vibe while making the world look more detailed and enjoyable to play in.!![Pixlera](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a56442bb857a1346a32d7584e6fd0cde7dd7ea0c.png)
